about_the_game:
The Type 99 - Cupid makes a grand debut! It features an ultra-fast 5.8-second loading speed that offers a great sense of control, an extremely high gun elevation angle of 8 degrees, an incredibly long range of 3800 meters, and an astonishingly high muzzle velocity, enabling you to dominate the battlefield.

Powerful Firepower Output: With an extremely fast gun loading speed of only 5.8 seconds, it can strike the enemy multiple times in a short period. The gun elevation angle reaches up to 8 degrees, combined with the long range of 3800 meters and high muzzle velocity, it performs outstandingly both in attacking distant targets and air defense.

Good Maneuverability: Among heavy tanks, the Type 99 - Cupid has relatively good maneuverability. It can quickly change positions, promptly support teammates or evade enemy attacks, making it suitable for mobile warfare.

Strong Reconnaissance Ability: Its ground detection range is 1700 meters, and the air detection range is 1680 meters. This allows it to detect enemies early on the battlefield and provide early warnings and intelligence support for its own side.

Come and take control of it to start your own battlefield legend!

The gift package includes:

Type 99 - Cupid

1000 Gold

The in-game items will be directly issued to your in-game backpack after purchase. Please go to check them within the game.

The DLC can only be added to your "Tank Arena: Total Action" account once.

This DLC is only applicable to game accounts created on the Steam platform.
